messages:
emily (Support): Hey team — customer 75012 reported a card decline during checkout. They say card was accepted by their bank previously. Getting AVS/CVV failure and payment gateway returned X31. Need quick triage.

payments-bot: Decline code: X31 (AVS mismatch). Acquirer: GlobalPay UK. Auth response: `CVV_FAIL=false, AVS=U, response_code=54`.

emily (Support): Thanks bot. Customer billing address: 'PO Box 42, High St, W1A 1AA, UK'. Shipping address was a physical address. Card issuer flagged AVS mismatch on billing address.

samir (Payments): Do we have last4/BIN? Also which connector (stripe/adyen/custom)?

emily (Support): Last4=4242 (sanitized), BIN=424242. Connector=Adyen via GlobalPay. Payload sent: `billingAddress.street="PO Box 42"` and `billingAddress.postalCode="W1A1AA"`.

jordan (Security): AVS rules differ by acquirer/country. PO Box often causes AVS U (unavailable). If CVV passed, we can allow fallback to 3DS attempt. Do we have CVV result?

emily (Support): CVV result from connector: `N` (not matched). Customer insists CVV was correct. They typed card on mobile.

samir (Payments): Two possibilities: 1) Gateway treats PO Box as mismatch and returns AVS=U for PO Boxes in some UK setups. Our connector config currently treats AVS!=MATCH as hard decline. We should change to: if avs==U and cvv==MATCH -> attempt auth or trigger 3DS. But cvv==N here.

jordan (Security): If both AVS & CVV fail, merchant liability shifts. For higher risk we require 3DS. We can trigger `threed_secure_required=true` on next attempt.

olga (Billing): Customer also mentions VAT in their company PO. Is there any chance tax/VAT validation is changing address format in our system and causing mismatch?

emily (Support): Billing info came from checkout form exactly as entered. No VAT normalization applied on billing address. VAT was provided in separate field.

samir (Payments): Pasting sanitized logs:
```
REQUEST -> provider: {"amount": 1250, "currency":"GBP", "card":{"number":"****4242","expiry":"04/26","cvc":"***"}, "billingAddress":{"street":"PO Box 42","city":"London","postalCode":"W1A1AA","country":"GB"}}
RESPONSE <- provider: {"resultCode":"Refused","refusalReason":"X31","avsResult":"U","cvvResult":"N","pspReference":"8817..."}
```

samir (Payments): Good. Can reproduce locally against test Adyen account with same payload — Adyen returns AVS=U for PO Boxes in some UK setups. Our connector config currently treats AVS!=MATCH as hard decline. We should change to: if avs==U and cvv==MATCH -> attempt auth or trigger 3DS. But cvv==N here.

jordan (Security): If both AVS & CVV fail, merchant liability shifts. For higher risk we require 3DS. We can trigger `threed_secure_required=true` on next attempt.

olga (Billing): Customer also mentions VAT in their company PO. Is there any chance tax/VAT validation is changing address format in our system and causing mismatch?

emily (Support): Billing info came from checkout form exactly as entered. No VAT normalization applied on billing address. VAT was provided in separate field.

samir (Payments): Action items: 1) Emily to ask customer to retry with physical street (if available) or try card without PO box. 2) Engineering (payments) to add a connector rule: treat AVS=U as soft-fail and attempt 3DS when CVV fails. 3) If customer needs immediate help, escalate to GlobalPay with PSP reference and request manual AVS override.

emily (Support): Agreed. I'll request a retry and offer guest checkout/alternate card. Also creating escalation ticket to GlobalPay with logs and PSP ref 8817...

jordan (Security): FYI — add a new metric to console for AVS=U rates per connector so we can see if GlobalPay has higher PO Box false-positive.

samir (Payments): I'll open a config PR to change AVS handling and add 3DS fallback. Tagging @eng-payments for review.

emily (Support): Customer replied — they can try another card. Sending them a one-time link. Closing this support thread pending customer result. Will update if GlobalPay responds. :thumbsup:
